test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

DECREASE
solution: The correct answer is '**Decline**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Decrease**' is '**Decline**'. • **Decrease**: to become or to make something smaller or less. (घटना या घटाना) • *Example: Profits have **decreased** by 15%.* • **Decline**: to become weaker, smaller, or less good. [(किसी का) ह्रास होना, क्षीण होना] • *Example: The standard of education has **declined** in this country.* **Correct Answer:__** *Decline.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Grow**: to increase in size or number; to develop into an adult form. (आकार या संख्‍या की दृष्टि से बढ़ना; बड़ा होना) • **Increase**: to become or to make something larger in number or amount. (संख्‍या या मात्रा में वृद्धि होना या करना, संख्‍या या मात्रा की दृष्टि से बढ़ना या बढ़ाना) • **Ascend**: to go up. (ऊपर चढ़ना; बढ़ना) 40:Te19, The correct answer is **'has started'.**
